title: Spec of an integral ring map is an integral morphism
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings which is integral (every element of $B$ is a root of a monic polynomial with coefficients in $\varphi(A)$). Then the induced morphism of schemes $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] (and conversely).
